3U ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"), made as of the_day ofAy ,2024,by andbetweenSEAWORLDFISHMARKET INC., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of New York, having an address at c/o Michael Novik, 54 Fern Road, East Brunswick, NJ 08816 (the “Owner"), and 1016 BEACH 19 PARTNERS LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 5925 Broadway, and each individually, a“Party"). WITNESSETH: 1. WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Queens,City and State of NewYork, known as Lot 1 in Block 15560 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and by the street address of 18-60 Cornaga Ave, Far Rockaway, New York and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed any other improvements thereon,together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,”and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); 2. WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough ofQueens,City and State ofNewYork,known as Lot8inBlock15560on theTaxMapoftheCityofNewYork andbythestreetaddress of10- 16 Beach 19th Street,Far Rockaway,NewYork and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Developer Land"); 3.WHEREAS,Developer desires andintends toconstruct oneor morenewbuildings orother improvements upon the Developer Land and/or other land as may be acquired by Developer from time to time (such new buildings and other improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, and collectively with any existing buildings or other improvements and/or any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement,beinghereinafter referred to as the“DeveloperBuilding,”theDeveloper Land and the Developer Building collectively referred to herein as the “Developer Premises"); 4. WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct the Developer Building with an amount of presently permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land was considered a zoning lot separate and independent from the Owner Land; 5. WHEREAS, there exists Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner Premiseswhich arein excessof theDevelopment Rights utilized by the OwnerBuilding,and the same may be utilized for future improvements and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; 1

6.WHEREAS,Owner and Developer desire toutilize theprocedure availablepursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Premises and the Developer Premises into a combined zoning lot (as such zoning lot may be enlarged by the addition of Additional Parcels thereto from time to time and/or subdivided as permitted by this Agreement, and any Additional Development Rights from Additional Parcels (as such terms are hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of the Developer Building; 7. WHEREAS, accordingly, pursuant to the procedure set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, Owner and Developer have executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") creating the Combined Zoning Lot, which Declaration is intended to be recorded simultaneouslyherewith; 8. WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of All New York Title Agency, Inc., intended to be recorded simultaneously herewith, have joined in the Declaration or have subordinated or previously subordinated their interests hereto; 9. WHEREAS, the Parties wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each Party to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other Party hereto; 10. WHEREAS, with reference to that certain Development Rights Purchase and Sale Agreement between the Parties, dated April 1, 2024 (the “Purchase Agreement"), the Parties wish to set forth a mechanism by which this Agreement is to be terminated in the event additional consideration is not paid by Developer to Owner (the “Conditional Termination"), together with a mechanism by which the Conditional Termination shall be extinguished by the Parties and be of no further force and effect upon Developer's payment of such consideration to Owner in accordance with the foregoing Purchase Agreement; NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.o0) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereto agree asfollows: 1.Certain Definitions. In addition to the capitalized terms that are defined throughout this Agreement and therecitals,as used herein: a.“Additional Parcels” shall mean any other parcel of land that is contiguous to any portion of the Combined Zoning Lot for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet or may otherwise be added to the Combined Zoning Lot pursuant to the provisions of the ZoningResolution or other applicable law.All references toAdditional Parcels shall be deemedtorefer toany oneAdditionalParcel or any combination of such Additional Parcels that Developer or Owner elects to include in the Combined Zoning Lot. 2
